answer: Each agent identity is bound to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE) and a hardware-rooted key, so a copied VM cannot reproduce the trusted quote or key. An attacker must provision genuine SGX/SEV hardware for another attested instance, raising the cost of Sybil identities beyond cheap virtual duplication. The oasis may host agents, but attestation is the harbor and beacon that let peers verify their measured code and hardware origin.
